heading: Is Mochi gluten free?
intro: This public analysis report explains the biggest gluten risks in Mochi and how to order more safely.

verdict.summary: Mochi is traditionally made from glutinous rice, which is gluten-free; however, cross-contamination with gluten-containing ingredients or improper preparation methods can pose a risk for those with coeliac disease. It's important to verify the specific ingredients and preparation practices used.

disclaimer: This guidance is informational only. Always verify ingredients and preparation with the restaurant.

sections.title: Quick answer
sections.body: Mochi can vary by recipe, ingredients, and cross-contact controls in the kitchen.

sections.title: Common gluten risks
sections.body: Watch for hidden sources like soy sauce, malt flavoring, marinades, thickeners, and shared fryers.

faq.question: Can BiteRight confirm if Mochi is gluten free?
faq.answer: BiteRight highlights likely gluten risks based on ingredients and preparation. Always confirm with the kitchen if you have coeliac disease.

faq.question: What should I ask a restaurant?
faq.answer: Ask about shared equipment, sauces, marinades, and whether the kitchen has a dedicated gluten-free prep area.
